extDescription.message: Hover over an English word to pop up a card with phonetics, definitions and a sentence translation — learn words through the rhythm of sentences with TTS pronunciation.
extDescription.description: Extension description (shown on the Web Store and in chrome://extensions)

popupModeHoverClick.message: Hover or click a word/phrase to open the popup (default)

popupModeHover.message: Only open the popup when hovering over a word/phrase

popupModeClick.message: Only open the popup when clicking or tapping a word/phrase

popupModeAltClickMac.message: Only open the popup when holding Option and clicking a word/phrase

popupModeAltClickWin.message: Only open the popup when holding Alt and clicking a word/phrase

popupModeCommandClick.message: Only open the popup when holding Command and clicking a word/phrase

popupModeHoverCommand.message: Only open the popup when hovering a word/phrase and pressing Command
popupModeHoverCommand.description: Popup trigger: hover then press Command

popupModeControlClick.message: Only open the popup when holding Ctrl and clicking a word/phrase

popupModeHoverControlMac.message: Only open the popup when hovering a word/phrase and pressing Control
popupModeHoverControlMac.description: Popup trigger: macOS hover then press Control

popupModeHoverControlWin.message: Only open the popup when hovering a word/phrase and pressing Ctrl
popupModeHoverControlWin.description: Popup trigger: Windows hover then press Ctrl

popupModeHint.message: Choose how the popup opens; the options shown depend on your system.

translatorHint.message: The translation service used for the sentence translation shown in the popup card.

phoneticsHint.message: Which phonetics to show in the popup card (only one at a time).

sentenceBreakLabel.message: How to break sentences when reading aloud

sentenceBreakComma.message: Break at commas (shorter chunks, easier to follow)

autoSpeakLabel.message: Automatically pronounce the word when the popup appears

sentenceSpeakLabel.message: Read the whole sentence with TTS instead of just the word

wordFirstLabel.message: Read the word first, then the whole sentence

stickyPopupLabel.message: Only close the popup when clicking outside, clicking the X icon, or pressing Esc

previewTextPlaceholder.message: Enter or paste some text, then click Play to read it aloud with the currently selected voice…

autoVoice.description: Automatic option in the voice dropdown

ariaEnableAll.description: Accessible label for the global toggle

openFullSettings.description: Popup footer button to open options

allDisabledDesc.message: All sites are disabled by default; you can enable individual sites

currentPage.description: Fallback text when the host is empty

speakLabel.description: Read-aloud button title in the popup card

speakSentenceLabel.description: Read sentence button in the popup footer bar

closeLabel.description: Close button title in the popup card

addSentenceLabel.description: Save (star) button title when the word is saved but this sentence is not

openWordbook.description: Popup footer button to open the wordbook page

navWordbook.description: Top nav tab for the wordbook page

navSettings.description: Top nav tab for the settings page
